messages:
Maya Chen: Short check-in: recent postmortems show two recurring authz problems — post-deploy token validation flaps and missing audit events during secret/rotation flows. Need a compact action plan + owners.

Devon Li: I can take a look at the post-deploy failures. Do we have a simple log snippet to bake into a smoke test?

Maya Chen: Paste from incident bundle:
```
ERROR authz token_validation: 'kid' not found in jwks, verified=false, req_id=tx-7e9
```

Harper Singh: On rotations, we saw async audit writes lose events when secure-log returned 429/503. Rotation handler didn't block on confirmation. Recommend blocking write-with-retries or transactional commit.

Ibrahim Noor: Quick proposals (2-week horizon):
- Devon: post-deploy smokecheck + CI gate (due 2026-07-10)
- Harper: rotation flow -> sync write+retry, rollback on persistent failure (due 2026-07-14)
- Maya: add weekly authz digest + anomaly alert (due 2026-07-03)
- Ibrahim: orphaned-creds sweep job and runbook (due 2026-07-17)

Devon Li: ack. I'll create a tiny curl-based smoke that validates a signed token against the new replicas and fail the deploy if invalid. Will add perf guard to avoid blocking long-running deploys.

Harper Singh: ack. I'll change the rotation path to synchronous write-with-confirm and add exponential backoff retries; also include integration test that simulates secure-log error codes.

Maya Chen: I'll add these to the remediation tracker and schedule a 30-min monthly "authz pulse" to review trends. If owner can't meet ETA, flag 48h before with reassignment proposal.

ops-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-7001 assigned to Devon Li, due 2026-07-10

ops-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-7002 assigned to Harper Singh, due 2026-07-14

Ibrahim Noor: One extra note: add a lightweight JWK prefetch on startup to reduce first-request flaps, and tie cache invalidation to rotation events so keys rotate atomically across services.

Devon Li: Good call. I'll add prefetch + short TTL and evaluate the impact in staging.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — I'll post the runbook link once the tracker is updated and ping before the first retro. :white_check_mark:
